Authors: The EasyList authors

Chinese rules: https://github.com/easylist/easylistchina
License: GPL v3 or CC BY-SA 3.0 (or later), subject to each subscription's terms.
https://easylist.to/pages/licence.html

Only subscription URLs are bundled, not third-party ad rules. Downloads retain source files and attribution.

Supports common URL rules, wildcards, domain restrictions, third-party conditions, @@ exceptions, standard CSS hiding and hiding exceptions. Resource types are matched only when WebView provides a definite type.

Rules with unsupported options or advanced syntax are skipped, including script fixes, redirects, regular expressions and procedural element matching. Main documents are not blocked directly; Service Worker requests are not handled. This is not a complete uBO/ABP engine.

Third-party domain checks use the Public Suffix List (Mozilla / community, MPL 2.0). https://publicsuffix.org/
Rules and settings can be backed up; downloaded caches and blocking logs are excluded."

"Resources are held in memory per tab and reset on navigation or reload. They are not included in backups. Turning collection off does not affect normal browsing; reload to fully enable or disable page observation.

Finding a URL does not guarantee a successful download. HTTP(S) resources can use the system downloader with the current cookies for that URL, browser user agent and source page at discovery.

HLS / DASH are playlists. Copy them or use an external downloader that supports them. Downloading a playlist does not merge segments. External apps receive only the URL and resource type, not cookies.

Blob URLs exist within the page and cannot be sent directly to a downloader. Look for related playlists or HTTP resources. Sniffing cannot decrypt DRM media.

Detection uses request URLs, page elements, loading records and response types, without reading response bodies. Not all cross-origin frames, Service Workers, redirects or encrypted players can be detected."

"Basic support: runs only in the main page, with URL matching, run timing and GM_addStyle. Scripts can read and modify matching pages. Install only trusted scripts."
"This WebView cannot inject at document start. document-start scripts cannot be enabled; other scripts run after the page loads."
"Does not support the full Tampermonkey API"

"Supports @match, @include wildcards, @exclude, @exclude-match, @run-at (start/end/idle), GM_addStyle / GM.addStyle, GM_log, GM_info and unsafeWindow.

Runs only in the main page, not in iframes. Scripts share the page's JavaScript environment, without a separate extension sandbox.

Advanced APIs such as @require, @resource, GM_xmlhttpRequest and GM_setValue are not supported; scripts declaring these requirements are rejected. There are no automatic updates or dependency downloads.

Export scripts individually as .user.js. They are not included in browser settings backups."

"Supports URL wildcards and regular expressions, start/body/end/idle, iframes (opt out with @noframes), cached @require / @resource, GM storage and change listeners, menu commands, styles and elements, resources, and GM_xmlhttpRequest / GM.xmlHttpRequest.

Requests follow @connect and do not automatically send browser login cookies. Text, JSON, ArrayBuffer, Blob and HTML document responses are supported. Clipboard writes require the GM_setClipboard grant.

Scripts share the page JavaScript environment; there is no isolated extension sandbox. Automatic updates, GM_download, notifications, cookie management and the full extension API are unavailable. Network dependencies require HTTPS; inline data dependencies are supported. Source limit: 2 MB. Response limit: 4 MB.

Exported .user.js contains only source. Dependencies are fetched again during installation. Script settings are excluded from browser settings backups."
